description: Search LuxAlgo's prop-firm catalog (proprietary trading firms offering funded accounts). Combine firm filters (platforms, markets, payment/payout methods, country availability, Trustpilot, year founded) with nested challenge filters (account size, price, steps, profit split, trading rules) and offer filters — a firm matches when at least one of its challenges/offers matches all of them. Omit every filter to list all firms. Use include to nest the matching challenges, live offers, and the written overview; for one firm's full dossier prefer propfirms_get. Uncaptured (null) fields are omitted from results; nested challenges reference offers via offerIds into the firm-level offers list. This tool returns directory data (what exists and on what terms), not outcomes: for simulated pass odds on a challenge found here, use propfirms_pass_rates or propfirms_simulate with its firm and challenge ids.

availableIn.description: Country names the firm must NOT restrict, e.g. ['United States']

challengeName.description: Case-insensitive substring of the challenge name

dailyLossMax.description: Upper bound on the daily-loss limit magnitude (smaller = stricter)

direction.description: Sort direction; each sort key has a sensible default

discountIsPercent.description: true for percent discounts, false for absolute amounts

hasActiveOffer.description: When true, the firm must currently have a live (active, unexpired) offer

include.description: Extra payloads to nest on each firm (only children matching the filters are returned)

includeExpired.description: When true, ended offers are not hidden (default false)

includeInactive.description: When true, inactive offers are not hidden (default false)

isFeeRefundable.description: Whether the challenge fee is refundable

isPreferredPartner.description: Only LuxAlgo preferred-partner firms when true

maxLossMax.description: Upper bound on the overall-loss limit magnitude

maxLossMode.description: Drawdown modes; challenges without a captured mode never match

minTradingDaysMax.description: Maximum required minimum trading days (finds less-strict challenges)

offerText.description: Case-insensitive search over promo code and offer descriptions

paymentMethods.description: Payment methods the firm must accept at least one of, e.g. 'Crypto', 'PayPal'

payoutMethods.description: Payout methods the firm must offer at least one of, e.g. 'Bank Transfer', 'Crypto'

productTypes.description: Product types the firm must offer at least one of, e.g. 'CFD', 'Futures'

promoCode.description: Case-insensitive substring of the promo code

steps.description: Exact evaluation step count (1 = instant/funded, 2 = two-step, …)

stepsMax.description: Maximum step count (ignored when steps is set)

stepsMin.description: Minimum step count (ignored when steps is set)

stoplossRequired.description: Whether a stop loss is required

text.description: Case-insensitive search over firm name and slug, e.g. 'ftmo'

tradedMarketTypes.description: Markets the firm must offer at least one of, e.g. 'forex', 'indices', 'commodities'

tradingPlatforms.description: Platforms the firm must offer at least one of, e.g. 'MT5', 'cTrader', 'TradingView'

weekendHolding.description: Whether holding over the weekend is allowed

name: propfirms_search
title: Search prop firms
